messages:
mira chen: quick heads-up — bringing int4-v3 into staging. perf looks great: ~12% lower p95 latency, ~40% cost reduction, but summarization slice ROUGE-L fell by ~3.1% vs float16. want proposals for rollout gating and auto-fallback thresholds.

samir: can you paste the slice-level numbers? and which prompt set?

mira chen: using newsroom prompts (v2026-02), short+long mixes. numbers from nightly harness:
```
summarization: baseline float16 42.5 -> int4-v3 41.2 (-3.1%)
qa: baseline 78.9 -> int4-v3 78.6 (-0.4%)
conversational: baseline 65.0 -> int4-v3 64.7 (-0.3%)
```
full-run: latency p95 down 12%, cost per token -40%

jen k: 3.1% on a single business-critical slice is non-trivial. propose a two-part gate: per-slice hard cap + weighted global budget.

liam: agree. concretely: per-slice absolute cap = 1.5% drop max. global weighted budget = 1.0% max weighted regression where weights = production traffic fraction * criticality multiplier.

eva: also add noise guard — only count signals that exceed 2x historical std for that slice to avoid flip-flopping on small variance.

samir: math example: summarization traffic 8% of requests, criticality multiplier 1.5 -> weight=0.12. if summarization delta = -3.1% -> weighted impact = 0.12*3.1 = 0.372%. that alone eats ~37% of a 1.0% global budget.

mira chen: nice. i like the "blast-radius budget" wording. what about automatic fallback thresholds?

jen k: fallback triggers: (a) any per-slice delta > 1.5% absolute -> immediate fallback for affected users; (b) global weighted delta > 1.0% -> rollback; (c) consecutive detection windows (5m windows) with >2x std for 3 windows -> rollback.

liam: add a safety hysteresis: require 2 consecutive good windows (weighted delta < 0.3%) before promoting again.

samir: small operational note: we should run a targeted shadow eval for the summarization slice with a larger sample to confirm. command used:
```
python infra/eval/runner.py --model int4-v3 --slices summarization --num-samples 5000 --metric rouge_l --seed 2026
```
will upload logs to /mnt/evals/int4-v3/summarization/3344556677.log

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: int4-v3 -> 5% traffic at 3344556680. Observability hooks enabled (per-slice metrics, live evals).

mira chen: timeline: if shadow confirm matches nightly (delta >1.8%), we stop promotion. if shadow delta ~= nightly but <1.5%, we proceed to 20% with close monitoring.

eva: one more idea — slice-weight tuning: temporarily downweight summarization traffic in routing for the canary while keeping overall traffic for other slices normal. that reduces immediate customer impact while allowing more signal collection.

jen k: agreed. ops action: implement per-route weight adjustment + automated rollback policy in rollout config. i'll open a small PR with the policy yaml.

samir: created quick smoke check notebook to visualize per-slice drift over time, link: https://kibana.example.com/app/dash/summary-int4-v3

mira chen: actions: 1) samir run targeted shadow eval (5000 samples) 2) jen PR for rollout policy (per-slice cap + weighted budget + hysteresis) 3) liam coordinate routing weight for summary slice 4) ops watch the canary until 3344556705 and report.

liam: done, will lower summarization route weight to 50% of its normal share for the canary cohort.

deploy-bot: Canary alert: at 3344556700 summarization delta reported -2.9% (ROUGE-L). auto-fallback policy not yet in prod.

mira chen: OK rollback planned if shadow eval confirms. thanks all. :thumbsup:
